appSingleton.name: Declare application as singleton
appSingleton.description: When set to true, Application Manager will suppress the launch splash for the app when an instance is already running. The value must be written under the subpath /<desktop-id> (the application desktop file ID). Intended for third-party applications that cannot modify their desktop files to add the X-Deepin-Singleton field.
